title: A drone with a Missile Launcher I or a Railgun I and autocannons strips the launcher at Central Nexus, stores it, and takes four rounds boxes
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-24 18:47 UTC (orders ENT-090 block APOPHIS: ammunition with every armed hull bought). Cause found: the listed Cleavers flew 26 hunts since 12:00 UTC with 0 kills (runs table, the three Cleavers). hunt.py advances only while the prey stands beyond the battle's "Max weapon reach"; a Missile Launcher I reaches 6 (catalog 0.734.3) and a fight starts at distance 6, so the ship never closes; its launcher holds no missiles (reload with a rounds box: wrong_ammo_type, a Cleaver's hunt log 18:28 to 18:39 UTC) and the autocannons reach 2. Without the launcher the largest reach is the autocannons' 2 and hunt.py closes in. Railgun I (reach 5, no slugs aboard) the same. Docked stop: unfit, store only the stripped modules (never store all: it would store the rounds), buy four standard rounds boxes (1 cr at Central Nexus, books 15:55 UTC), once. Put in the own rows of the ships that carry the launcher, never First (the flagships fly the sentinel plan's lists). Test (F37): three hunts of a stripped Cleaver read kills before any more are bought.
